_comment: Event travel guide, used as the template for future events: the Green Party Conference at the Brighton Centre, 2 to 4 October 2026. Shown in the section menu until show_until, then hidden. The words are written by hand; walking minutes, hotel areas' quickest way and data/conference_stops.json come from scripts/build_event_guide.py, using the derive block. Walking minutes are straight-line metres from venue.walk_point x 1.3, at 80 m a minute; bus routes are the direct ones from our timetable on the derive day and hours. See docs/RUNBOOK.md, 'Event travel guides'.

derive.venue_stops_note: Clock Tower, Churchill Square, North Street, Brighton Centre and Ship Street, both directions

venue.name: Brighton Centre
notes: On the seafront. Main entrance on Kings Road, rear entrance on Russell Road; both are step-free.
There is a security check at the door. Food and drink cannot be taken in, except for medical reasons.
No car park of its own. Blue Badge drop-off lay-bys are at the front and back.
Cycle racks at the front and rear.

nearest_stops.name: Brighton Centre
nearest_stops.hint: Sat and Sun only: route 77, 8 a day. No Friday service

station.name: Brighton Station
station.walk_text: 15 minutes, downhill all the way and step-free: out of the main exit onto Queen's Road, straight down Queen's Road and West Street to the sea. The venue is on the right.
station.bus_text: From the stops outside the station front to the Clock Tower or Churchill Square, about 5 minutes; a bus every few minutes.
station.back_text: Going back is uphill. For a flat walk instead, go east along the seafront or North Street to Old Steine (about 10 minutes), where buses run to the station.
station.taxi: A taxi rank is at the back of the station, on Stroudley Road.

coaches.name: National Express: Pool Valley coach station (Old Steine)
coaches.how: A flat 10 minute walk west along the seafront to the venue.

coaches.name: FlixBus: Stroudley Road, behind Brighton Station
coaches.how: Walk through to the station front (about 5 minutes), then follow the station directions above.

coaches.name: FlixBus: Preston Park (London Road)
coaches.how: About 2 km north of the centre. Take a bus heading into town.

text: The Brighton Centre has no car park, and Brighton has no park-and-ride.
Churchill Square 1 car park (West Street) is opposite the rear entrance, 30 metres away.
Regency Square car park is under the square, 250 metres west along the seafront.
Parking in central Brighton is expensive and fills on busy days. If you can, come in by train or bus.

on_site: Several socials are in the Brighton Centre itself (East Bar, Syndicate 1 and 2, Meeting Room 15). Times and tickets are on the organisers' list.
tickets: Tap a contactless card or phone on the reader when you board. Brighton & Hove Buses cap what you pay in a day, so you never pay more than a day ticket.
A single fare in England is capped at £3.
Stagecoach runs the 700, N700 and 17, and has its own tickets: a Brighton & Hove day ticket is not valid on them.

taxi_ranks.name: Queen's Square, top of West Street by the Clock Tower
Kings Road, on the seafront east of West Street
Brighton Station, at the back on Stroudley Road

accessibility: From Brighton Station it is a step-free walk of about 950 metres, all downhill. The way back is uphill: take a bus from the Clock Tower or Churchill Square, or walk on the flat along the seafront to Old Steine (about 10 minutes) for buses 7, 12, 12X, 14, 20 and 27 to the station.
Every bus here is low-floor with a wheelchair space, and a manual ramp for step-free boarding is available: ask the driver.
Blue Badge drop-off: lay-bys at the front and back of the venue.

Churchill Square 1 car park has accessible bays on every level; park on P1 if you can, as it is the exit level. From the exit it is 30 metres, on the level, across a crossing with dropped kerbs, to the rear entrance. Regency Square car park has no lift and a steep slope at the exit, then a flat 250 metres along the seafront.
late_night: Night buses run from the Clock Tower and North Street after the day services stop: N1, N5, N7, N12, N14 and N700 (Stagecoach, to Worthing). Check the live board for the next one.
